metadata.description: Plugins that make Claude Code's work checkable: engineering guidance for how the work is done.

plugins.name: engineering-doctrine
plugins.description: Guides Claude Code to trace root causes, establish ownership and invariants, change only what the task requires, verify behavior with evidence, preserve existing work and user data, and review the result before claiming completion.

plugins.name: architecture-governance
plugins.description: Governs architecture and specification work with semantic ownership, explicit contracts, stable documentation rules, evidence-backed probes, and disciplined completion gates.
